The sample has n = 2541, and the sample proportion supporting wind turbine expansion is p̂ = 2160/2541 ≈ 0.85.

The sampling distribution of a proportion is approximately normal when the success-failure condition holds. That condition needs at least 10 expected successes and at least 10 expected failures. Here there are about 2160 successes and 381 failures. Both are well above 10. The survey is also a large sample of US adults, so the observations can reasonably be treated as independent. A normal model is reasonable.

ANSWER: yes
